intro: Bring Back a Bang is a task to recover volatile blasting powder stolen from a local construction site. Hostile Dark Iron dwarves have hauled the marked barrels east to their camps on Direforge Hill, posing a grave threat to the area if left unchecked.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.
I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!
I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
